exposure: Women previously experiencing a pregnancy of an RhD-positive child
National population data from the Dutch perinatal registration (Perined)
cohort: Two-year nationwide cohort of alloimmunised RhD-negative women in the Netherlands
finding: Complicated deliveries, including cases of major bleeding and surgical interventions (CS, MRP), were significant risk factors for RhD immunisation in RhD-negative women, even with routine antenatal and postnatal RhIg prophylaxis.
mod_finding: Caesarean section and manual removal of the placenta were identified as risk factors for RhD immunisation.
